title: Edit and delete your own messages in the desktop app
spec: Command::Edit { room, target, text } and Command::Delete { room, target }; Composer::submit_edit trims and refuses like submit. In the window, clicking one of your own messages selects it (a second click clears it) and shows Edit and Delete under it; other people's messages cannot be selected. Edit puts the message's text in the composer, which says it is editing, offers Cancel editing, and saves (Action::Room(Command::Edit)) instead of sending. Delete asks 'Delete this message?' with Delete and Keep. The worker sends the edit or deletion, reports Event::Changed and syncs the room; a refusal is reported and the session stays open. End to end against a running server: a posted message is edited (same cursor, marked edited, new text only) and then deleted (gone from the snapshot).
